issues.title: Test an inline TOML request through the stdio protocol
issues.why: Protocol v1 promises inline TOML, while the CLI integration test currently exercises inline YAML.
acceptance: Add one focused CLI or protocol test that sends the checked-in request unchanged.
Assert ok=true, the same request_id, and two non-empty hash-described artifacts.
Do not change the protocol schema or add a TOML dependency.

issues.title: Cover DOCX-only output in protocol v1
issues.why: The protocol supports pdf=false, but its CLI contract test currently requests both artifacts.
acceptance: Send the checked-in request through rusdox serve stdio in a test.
Assert exactly one DOCX artifact and no PDF file.
Keep existing dual-output behavior unchanged.

issues.title: Assert the protocol v1 unknown-version error contract
issues.why: Unknown protocol versions must fail explicitly so integrations never guess future semantics.
acceptance: Add a test using the fixture without rewriting its protocol_version.
Assert ok=false, error.code=invalid_request, and no output files.
Keep the process available for the next request when max-requests is greater than one.

issues.title: Add a regression test for unsafe protocol artifact names
issues.why: Output confinement also depends on rejecting separators and punctuation in artifact stems.
acceptance: Exercise the checked-in request through the public protocol function or CLI.
Assert error.code=invalid_output and that no outside.docx file appears.
Do not weaken the existing ASCII safe-name rule.

issues.title: Cover HTTP 415 for non-JSON protocol requests
issues.why: The loopback adapter rejects non-JSON bodies, and that defensive response should remain executable evidence.
acceptance: Add one bounded loopback test based on the raw request fixture.
Assert HTTP 415 and error.code=unsupported_media_type.
Do not add CORS or broaden the bind address.

issues.title: Test an empty signed-registry search result in JSON mode
issues.why: Automation should receive a successful empty templates array instead of an error for a valid query with no matches.
acceptance: Reuse the signed local-registry test helper and the query fixture.
Assert exit code 0, signed=true, and templates=[] in JSON output.
Do not make network requests.

issues.title: Cover category matching in signed template search
issues.why: Category search is user-facing discovery behavior and deserves a small regression assertion.
acceptance: Search the signed local registry using the fixture text.
Assert invoice and proposal are present and board-report is absent.
Keep ordering identical to the signed registry.

issues.title: Add a minimal JSON authoring example
issues.why: The schema supports JSON, but the public examples folder is intentionally YAML-heavy and lacks a tiny copyable JSON entry.
acceptance: Add the fixture as a clearly named example without changing its content.
Document the render command and expected DOCX/PDF names in examples/README.md.
Run validate and verify successfully; do not add the file to the flagship gallery.

issues.title: Add a minimal TOML authoring example
issues.why: A checked-in TOML example would make the existing parser support easier to discover without expanding the gallery.
acceptance: Add the fixture as a clearly named example without changing its content.
Document validate and render commands in examples/README.md.
Assert both artifacts render; do not introduce format-specific semantics.

issues.title: Add a standard-library PowerShell protocol example
issues.why: Windows users have installer coverage but no copyable stdio protocol example beside Node, Python, Go, and shell.
acceptance: Add examples/integrations/powershell.ps1 using the checked-in request and no external module.
Check ok=true plus non-empty DOCX/PDF files under the supplied output root.
Run it from scripts/test_integrations.mjs only when pwsh is available and document the optional path.
